};
export const getRoomsByPriceRange = (min, max) => {

};

};

// 🛏️ FUNCIONES ÚTILES
export const getRoomById = (id: string): Property | undefined => {
  return ACCOMMODATION_ROOMS.find(room => room.id === id);
};

export const getAvailableRooms = (): Property[] => {
  return ACCOMMODATION_ROOMS.filter(room => room.isAvailable);
};

export const getRoomsByPriceRange = (min: number, max: number): Property[] => {
  return ACCOMMODATION_ROOMS.filter(room => 
    room.pricePerNight >= min && room.pricePerNight <= max
  );
};

export const getRoomsByGuests = (guests: number): Property[] => {
  return ACCOMMODATION_ROOMS.filter(room => room.maxGuests >= guests);
};

export const getInstantBookRooms = (): Property[] => {
  return ACCOMMODATION_ROOMS.filter(room => room.isInstantBook && room.isAvailable);
};
